UI_PNC_Trait_Gay_Description: Can be romantically attracted to people of the same gender.
UI_PNC_Trait_Bisexual_Description: Can be romantically attracted to men and women.
UI_PNC_Trait_SpiceLover_Description: Prefers strongly seasoned and spicy food.
UI_PNC_Trait_Flirty_Description: Is comfortable expressing romantic interest early.
UI_PNC_Trait_Reserved_Description: Requires greater familiarity before expressing romantic interest.
UI_PNC_Trait_Jealous_Description: Reacts more strongly to perceived romantic rivalry.
UI_PNC_Trait_Unpossessive_Description: Reacts less strongly to harmless romantic attention involving a partner.
UI_PNC_Trait_Friendly_Description: Forms positive first impressions more easily but is affected more by prolonged isolation.
UI_PNC_Trait_Withdrawn_Description: Builds familiarity more slowly but is less affected by isolation.
